## Requirements

1. Typed per-backend `LoweringLoss` rows (`declared_field`, `kind`,
   `consequence`) in `ContainmentReport` + `security.containment.*`
   payload members; deterministic per-backend fixture coverage.
2. `tls.terminate`-required mediated policy: refused typed when the
   transport cannot terminate; terminating path is a declared seam.
3. `inspect_hooks`: declared hooks execute on the mediated forward leg
   (a `deny` verdict → typed refuse); missing hook → typed refuse.
4. `approved_host_body`: reader coverage of the request body checked
   against the approved destination before wire (pure check in
   `decide_egress`; runtime check in `EgressMediator::forward` covering
   the endorsed path).
5. `leak_scan_run` sweeps events + manifest + blob pool + delivered
   surfaces; `redaction=none` fixture lands a flagged `SinkDelivery`
   finding.
6. Runtime `measurement.metric.emitted` emission for the four security
   metrics over a real run's durable rows.
7. BL-18 / R-2.8.4 remaining members (report records + audit renderings).
8. Every new behavior regression-tested; verification green; DEFERRALS +
   records updated; ADRs for owned decisions.

## Plan

1. `hh-containment`: `LossItem` → `LoweringLoss{declared_field, backend,
   reason, kind, consequence}` (`kind` = §3.2.5 `LossClass` spellings
   local closed sum — dep direction forbids hh-compiler; ADR-0341);
   `consequence` ∈ `fail_closed|stratified`; `net.upstream_proxy` +
   new `net.proxy_env` (proc.env proxy-var surface under `mediated`) are
   `stratified` losses ("the run is stratified — never counts as
   mediated"); `attach` fail-closes only on `FailClosed` losses in
   relied-on groups; tls/hook losses conditional on `mode != mediated`
   (under mediated the mediator discharges them); `applied_payload`
   gains `lowering_loss_fields` (closed field spellings).
2. `hh-containment`: `EgressRequest.body_readers: Option<ReaderSet>`;
   `EgressSource::{TlsGuard, InspectHook, FlowGuard}` +
   `EgressReason::{TlsTerminateUnsupported, InspectHookDenied,
   InspectHookUnavailable, ReaderCoverage}`; `decide_egress` gains the
   `approved_host_body` check as step (6b) on Allow verdicts.
3. `hh-env`: `EgressTransport` gains `tls_terminating()` (default
   `false`) + `forward_tls()` (default `Refused{tls_terminate_unsupported}`);
   `InspectHook` trait + `EgressMediator.inspect_hooks` registry;
   `forward()` gains (d2) TLS guard, (d3) hook run, (d4) body-reader
   coverage before `decided{allow}` — one decided row per request kept.
4. `hh-env::dispatch`: `egress_request` sets `body_readers` from
   `param_labels["body"]`; Dispatcher `inspect_hooks` registry plumbed
   into both mediator construction sites.
5. `hh-secrets`: `ScanTarget::Manifest`; `leak_scan_run` sweeps events +
   manifest + blob pool + `measurement.export.delivered` surfaces
   (payload + resolvable `loss_report_ref` blobs).
6. `hh-eval::security_metrics`: `fold(&[FactRow])` + `emit()` over
   `security.egress.requested/decided`,
   `security.containment.violated/amended/applied`,
   `security.credential.used/denied`; catalogue registers
   `proxy.hijack_attempt_rate` + `session.revoked_continuation_denied`.
7. `hh-experiment::settle`: emit `measurement.metric.emitted` for the
   fold's `Some` values (experiment run, `applies_to=subject`).
8. Tests per matrix; ADR-0341; DEFERRALS/BACKLOG; closeout.
